Today Mom gave me

My dad is the king.

I'm really scared to go
to the bathroom alone
at night.

But Dad isn't scared
of even that.

Dad is amazing!

Today Jiya told me.

Even Dad has just
one thing he's afraid of.

But what it is
is a secret, he says.

I asked all sorts of ways,
but Jiya just kept
laughing and wouldn't
tell me.

It isn't caterpillars.
It isn't green peppers

Hmm... What could
Dad be afraid of?

Today I asked how I can
get strong like Dad.

Dad told me it's not
giving up, even when
you fail.

He failed at all kinds of
things many times, too.

But he didn't give up,
and by working hard
he became strong.

From now on I won't give
up when I fail either.

Lately Dad and Mom are
both really busy.

So I'm alone all the time.

Dad, Mom,
good luck at work.

Today there was a book
of spacetime magic in
Dad's room.

Nobody was around, so
I read it in secret.

When you cast spacetime
magic, for just a moment

you can see all kinds of
worlds between your
hands.

Spacetime magic is so
much fun!

Today I was playing with
spacetime magic in the
storeroom.

Jiya said it's a very
difficult magic and that
I'm amazing, and praised
me.

I was so happy!

Today I showed Dad and
Mom my spacetime magic,
the thing I'm proud of.

I thought they'd be
happy, but they got
really angry at me.

It's dangerous, so I must
never use it again.

It isn't dangerous
at all, though...

They could praise me
a little, at least...

Dad loves steak.

But he always eats too
much, so Mom banned it
long ago.

So Dad eats it in secret
where Mom can't find him.

Today too, we sneaked out
of the castle and went to
eat together, just the
two of us.

But he said it's a secret
between us because he's
scared of Mom.

So the thing Dad fears
is Mom, after all.

Jiya takes care of me
in all sorts of ways.
He's a kind old man.

Jiya is kind, so I can
talk to him about things
I can't tell Dad or Mom.

But Jiya is old, so
he'll die before me.

If Jiya dies first,

I won't be able to see
Jiya anymore.

That would be so sad.

Live a long life, Jiya.

Today Jiya made me
a promise!

He'll live a long life
until I grow up,

and stay with me forever
and ever!

Thank you, Jiya!

Lately Dad and Mom do
nothing but work,

so I mostly stay home
by myself.

But there's a good side.

When Dad and Mom aren't
around, I can play with
spacetime magic and
not get scolded.

Spacetime magic is still
so much fun!

Today I was playing in
the castle storeroom
in secret,

and Mom caught me.

She even saw me using
spacetime magic.

I tried to fool her, but
she got even angrier.

After that, both Dad and
Mom scolded me a lot.

I'd better not use
spacetime magic for
a while...

Today Dad and Mom

scolded Jiya for not
looking after me properly.

I said, "I'm the one who
did it, so be angry only
at me!"

They got even angrier and
said, "Children be quiet!"

They're always telling me
to hurry up and grow up.

This is so unfair!

I wish Dad and Mom would
just go away somewhere
and never come back!

My head is pounding!

It hurts so much...

Mom said I can skip
school...

Later Jiya secretly
brought me ice cream.

Jiya's ice cream was
really delicious...

My head hurts all day
again today...

The doctor came and
looked me over.

He said I'll get better
soon, but I don't think
so.

It keeps getting
harder...

It really hurts...

Somebody help me...

Even asleep, my head
hurts and I wake up
right away...

Soon after I wake, my
whole body starts to
hurt and it's awful...

I don't want to be awake,
but I can't sleep...

So I pretended to sleep,

and Mom, sitting by me,
was crying all alone...

Why was Mom crying?

Mom made me take bitter
medicine.

I threw it up again
and again,

but Mom got angry with a
scary face, so I tried
hard and swallowed it.

Then I got so sleepy
and fell asleep right
away.

Good night...

My head doesn't hurt
today!

I feel so refreshed.

The pain up till
yesterday seems like a
lie!

That bitter medicine must
have worked!

Since I took that
medicine, I haven't seen
Dad and Mom at all...

Jiya says they have very
important work and

can't come home for
a while.

Because I got better,
they went right back
to work, didn't they...

I'm so lonely...

Please come home soon...

Today Jiya told me.

I had a big sister.

But she died in a
spacetime magic accident
before I was born.

I was shocked, but
somehow I didn't feel
very sad.

But while he was talking,
Jiya looked so sad...

Watching Jiya made me
feel lonely too.

Dad, Mom,
come home soon...

I want to see you...

Today Jiya kept coughing
and looked to be in pain.

He said he's fine,
but...

Tomorrow I'll call
the doctor for him.

He said Jiya has a
serious illness
of the chest,

and that there's no
hope for him.

That's a lie...

Jiya and I made
a promise!

So Jiya won't die
until I grow up!

Jiya can't die.
That's a lie!

Today Jiya told me.

That I had an illness
that couldn't be cured,

and that Dad and Mom
used Tobas' Secret Art,
which blows away any
illness,

and succeeded, and
cured my illness...

And that because of the
backlash of Tobas'
Secret Art,

Dad and Mom were thrown
into another dimension...

It was a lie...
They weren't unable to
come home because of work.

They were thrown into
another dimension to cure
my illness, so they
can't come back...

I'll never see Dad and
Mom again...

I'm sad that I can't
see Dad and Mom,

but right now I have to
save Jiya!

Just like Dad and Mom
did,

if I use Tobas' Secret
Art,

I should be able to blow
away even Jiya's illness!

Wait for me, Jiya!

To make Tobas' Secret
Art work,

two people with immense
magic power, bound by a
strong bond,

have to chant the spell
at the same time...

That means I can't use
Tobas' Secret Art alone...

And that much magic
power,

I can't produce even with
the pendant Mom left me...

I have to find some
other way...

I have to hurry...
Jiya...!

I have to hurry!

Jiya died today...

I was so sad, so sad,
and the tears wouldn't
stop...

If only I'd been
stronger...

If I'd known many more
kinds of magic...

Maybe I could have
saved Jiya...

If only I'd been
stronger...

Maybe I wouldn't have had
to be separated from
Dad and Mom...

It's my fault...

It's all my fault...

I can't see Jiya
anymore,

but Dad and Mom are
still alive somewhere
in an unknown dimension.

So if I find a way to
get to that dimension,

I should be able to see
Dad and Mom.

There must be some way.

I won't give up.

I'll get back the
happiness I can get back

with my own hands!

It was written in the
dark grimoire:

the forbidden spacetime
magic, Grand Cross!

If it succeeds,

the worlds of every
dimension will be
linked into one!

If it succeeds, it should
connect to the world
where Dad and Mom are
too!

To chant the Grand Cross
spell,

I'd need immense power,
20 times my own
magic power...

My magic power is just
not enough...

What should I do...

What can I do...

It was written in the
dark grimoire in Jiya's
room!

The Sacrifa Circle, which
temporarily amplifies
magic power.

The price is that I'd
lose most of my magic
power forever,

but with this circle,
I should get 20 times my
current power!

Every preparation for
Grand Cross is finished!

Starting tomorrow night,
I'll begin the Grand
Cross ritual!

No matter what, I'll make
the Grand Cross ritual
succeed!

After the Grand Cross
ritual ended, I seem to
have lost consciousness
for a while...

I can't stand up...

But I can feel the pulse
of a new dimension.

My Grand Cross must have
succeeded!

The pain has eased a lot
and I can just about
walk.

Only a little,
but my magic power seems
to be recovering too.

If it recovers a bit
more, I might be able to
chant spells again.

Today when I left the
castle, an unknown world
stretched out before me!

Grand Cross really did
succeed!

But there are lots of
giant monsters that
won't listen, and it's
quite dangerous.

To tame these monsters,
my magic power has to
recover a bit more.

If I push myself here,
it'll all be ruined...

If I can tame the
monsters, they might be
useful when the time
comes...

For now I'll wait for my
magic power to recover...

The scorching world,

the world of ice,

the world of shining
stars,

I search and search,
but I can't find Dad or
Mom anywhere...

Maybe...

it didn't connect to
where Dad and Mom
are...

My magic power has
recovered quite a bit,

so over the last few days
I tried a calling spell...

But there's no response
from anywhere...

If Dad and Mom were in
one of the worlds Grand
Cross connected,

there's no way they'd not
answer a calling spell
from their own family...

So it really didn't
connect to where Dad
and Mom are...

It was a failure...

None of it meant
anything...

If only I hadn't gotten
sick...

None of this

would have happened...!

Long ago,
Dad taught me.

Everyone fails.

That's exactly why you
must not give up just
because you failed.

If I give up here,
it really will all be
for nothing.

If I perform Grand Cross
once more, this time it
should surely connect!

But with my current
power,

even using the Sacrifa
Circle, my magic power
is nowhere near enough...

I have to think of
some other way...

I won't give up!

That's it!

If my magic power is
not enough,

I can just have someone
else chant the spell!

With the last Grand Cross
we connected this many
different worlds.

Somewhere there must be
someone with magic power
strong enough to endure
the Grand Cross chant!

That one is the key to
getting my happiness
back!

I'll definitely find
them!

I finally found her!

What an incredible
magic power reading!

Princess Sasha, of the
true royal bloodline,
who lives in the surface
world!

This human should be
able to chant the Grand
Cross spell in my place!

But the humans of the
surface, though very
intelligent,

will do anything for
their own goals; the old
records call them a cruel
and savage tribe.

I have no choice but to
drag her into the dungeon
and somehow make her
chant the spell.

Anyway, this human is the
key to getting my
happiness back!

The cruel, savage world
of humans...

It's a little scary,

but if I wear Dad's
mask, they can't see my
face, and my voice will
sound grown-up too.

Dad will surely lend me
his strength...

If I act like Dad,
I'll be all right...

I managed to bring Sasha
to the dungeon.

But Sasha won't help me
at all...

She says that if we do
Grand Cross again,

every world now connected
will collapse.

Is she talking nonsense
to make me give up?

It's true that spacetime
has become unstable...

But the first time it was
fine.

The next time should be
fine too...

No matter what I say,
Sasha won't cooperate,

so today I threatened
her: I'll kill your
father.

Then she started crying
and did as I said right
away.

At last I can go ahead
with preparing the
second Grand Cross.

Just a little more...

When this ritual is over,

this time it should
surely connect to where
Dad and Mom are.

Just as Sasha says,

pieces.

this lonely feeling will
all vanish together.

Either way, this is
where it all ends.
